name: Pathway Karate Academy Summer & Vacation Camps
description_short: A day camp at a Providence karate school for ages 5-13 (grades PK-6). Campers do karate, sports, arts & crafts, weekly math and STEM labs, and reading, plus field trips. The page names this year's theme as Nature & Our Environment.
swim_waterfront_notes: Field trips include swimming and splash parks at Pleasant View Elementary School. The page does not describe swim instruction or supervision.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: SUMMER & VACATION CAMPS | Pathway Karate Academy | CCAP Accepted

warnings: The page gives no season year or dates. It says only 'This year', and the copyright is 2026, so this may be the 2026 summer, which has already ended. Prices and the field-trip lineup may change for 2027.
Prices say 'From', so the actual rate may be higher. Sibling rates are lower: $200 to $225 per week per child for 2-3 children.

The pricing tiers don't quite match. 'Before & Day Camp' (6:30AM-5PM, $235) lists only snacks, while the shorter 'Full Day Camp Only' ($220) lists breakfast, lunch and snacks. Also, the Extended sibling rate ($225) is the same as the Before & Day sibling rate.
financial_aid is set to true because the camp accepts the state child care subsidy (DHS/CCAP), not because it offers its own scholarships.
The camp is run by a karate school, but the program is a general day camp, not a karate-only specialty camp.
